summary: Found while chasing an unrelated H3 speed report. Evidence is the user's own .meta sidecars: 7 ref2v_ms runs, and every one that ran at the DEFAULT refImageSize recorded op: null while both runs where he touched the control recorded the key. Carded rather than fixed inline because the snapshot feeds every Reuse Prompt path.

note: Starting fix (1): extract the PromptBox control-visibility gate, then backfill resolved defaults into the snapshot buckets.

Fix (1) from the brief, shipped, plus the extraction it needed. visibleControlIds (PromptBoxControls) now owns the control-visibility gate that used to be 13 inline continues in MpiPromptBox._refreshOpSlot, and resolveControlDefaults resolves each visible control default through the op/model/global layers. _snapshotControlState merges those UNDER the stored values in all three buckets, and the ratio/batch reconciles no longer require the key to pre-exist. ratio, batch and qualityTier opt out via snapshotDefault:false (their stored shape is not their defaultValue). PROVEN LIVE in the renderer, not argued: the extracted gate matches the pre-refactor one on all 138 model x op x historyMode cases with zero diffs; minimax-h3-ref2va/ref2v_ms now yields op:{refImageSize:match} - the exact reported miss; chroma stylization resolves 0.6 and qwenEdit 0.8, so the layer order is right; wan-22 gets motionIntensity and ltx-23 does not, which is the cross-model shared-bucket clobber the gate prevents; and buildPromptReuseSettings carries that op bucket into a non-empty opUpdates, so applyPromptReuseSettings guard passes. Tests: tests/reuse-snapshot-defaults.test.cjs, 4, both negative-controlled. Suite 499/499. Docs: playbooks/common/prompt-box-controls.md + project-integrity.md. OWED: the user clicking Reuse Prompt on a fresh default-valued run. Existing sidecars stay unfixable - the value was never recorded.
